prompt: Create a production-ready original pixel-art environment illustration for a personal portfolio website named Starlight Cat Town. Wide landscape 1536x1024. Authentic meticulously hand-pixelled 16-bit life-simulation game art, high saturation, crisp visible square pixels, no blurry rendering, NO text, NO lettering, NO UI, no frames or logos. Nighttime creative village beneath an indigo star-filled sky and slim crescent moon, bright golden stars, layered cobalt mountains in distance, violet shadows, luscious emerald/teal trees, coral and cyan flowers, warm orange light spilling from windows. Slight elevated front-facing 3/4 RPG perspective, NOT isometric diamond. Composition: top 18 percent is open starry sky and mountain silhouettes. Six clearly separated visitable landmarks arranged in a legible two-row village connected by winding warm ochre cobblestone paths around a small circular star mosaic courtyard: upper left cozy two-story terracotta-roof cottage and balcony with plants; upper middle teal-roof inventor workshop with copper telescope and small gear sign; upper right violet-roof cinema with a large glowing golden star sign and orange awning. Lower left lush walled garden with wooden arbor, flowers and a game-like chess stone path; lower right wooden announcement board with small notes and a little red mailbox on a post beside it. A jewel-blue stream and small bridge near bottom left; detailed bushes, stepping stones and trees at edges, no big empty flat areas. Buildings individually substantial and detailed, make interactive locations distinguishable without needing text. Leave courtyard centre open for a separate character sprite to be added. A few tiny friendly cats sleeping at windowsills and roofs. Rich intentional lighting using limited clustered palette. Professional indie-game environment quality. Every asset original; evoke the comforting exploration richness of Stardew Valley without copying any exact layout, assets or characters.
